DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、申し訳ありません

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 明日の当番、行けなくなってしまいました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 朝は微熱だったのですが、先ほど計ったら上がっていまして……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっ、大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 薬を飲んだら多少は良くなりました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただ、この状態で行っても迷惑をかけてしまいそうで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 必ず埋め合わせはいたします

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ゆっくり休んでね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何かあったら連絡してね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとうございます、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こんにちは、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おかげで体調はだいぶ良くなりました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生はいかがですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私は元気だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もう大丈夫なの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい、おかげさまで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それより、ご都合がよろしければ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今週末、私の部屋に来ていただけませんか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: また行って良いの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あら

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 模様替えを手伝ってくださるんですよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まさか、忘れていたなんてことは……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あ、当たり前だよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 念のため聞いただけだよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふ、そんなに慌てなくても大丈夫ですよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 冗談ですから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでは、楽しみにしていますね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、大丈夫ですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ユウカちゃんから、風邪を引いたと聞きました

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今はゆっくり休んでるから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は否定されるかもしれませんが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もしかして

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私のせいかもしれないと思うと……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ノアのせいじゃないよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 気にしないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ですが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、明日のご予定は決まっていますか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 差し支えなければ、お見舞いに行かせてください

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 特に予定はないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: セミナーの仕事は大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お仕事は、終えてますので

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 明日はシャーレに伺いますね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 雨続きだったせいか、涼しくなりましたね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただ、制服が乾きにくいので困りました

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すごくわかる……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 生乾きも気になるよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ノアは何着制服を持ってるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 全部で4着ですね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ミレニアムは制服のルールが厳しくないので

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何着も持っている生徒は少ないですが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私はセミナーの一員ですから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そういえば、ノアの私服姿を見たことないような

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと残念……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そのうちお見せしますから

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 죄송합니다만, 내일 예정된 샬레의 당번 업무를 수행하기 어려울 것 같아서요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아침부터 약간의 미열이 있었는데, 오후에는 상태가 더 나빠져서…

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 큰일이네. 몸이 많이 안 좋은 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 걱정하실 정도는 아녜요. 약을 먹고 나니 지금은 괜찮아진 것 같아요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다만 이 상태로 샬레에 갔다가는 오히려 선생님께 더 폐를 끼칠 것 같아서…

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 내 걱정은 말고 일단은 푹 쉬어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 일 있으면 언제든 연락 주고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이번주 주말에 제 방에 한 번 더 와주시지 않겠어요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지난번 병문안을 오셨을 때, 다음에 제 방을 꾸미는 걸 도와주기로 하셔놓고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 설마 그사이에 약속을 잊으신 건 아니시겠지요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다른 학생으로부터 전해 들었는데 감기에 걸리셨다고…

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나는 괜찮아. 덕분에 오랜만에 쉬고 있으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 전에 제 병문안을 오셨다 제게 감기가 옮은 건 아닐지

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇다면 내일 점심 즈음에 병문안을 가도 괜찮을까요?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮습니다. 병가 중 밀린 업무는 이미 완벽히 다 처리했으니까요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 요 며칠간 비가 계속 내린 덕분에 시원해진 건 좋지만

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 세탁한 교복이 좀처럼 마르질 않아서 큰일이네요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 빨래를 너무 오래 널어두면 냄새가 날 때도 있으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 노아는 교복을 몇 벌이나 가지고 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 밀레니엄의 복장 규칙은 그렇게 엄격하지는 않은지라

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 같은 교복을 여러 벌 가지고 있는 학생은 거의 없겠지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 노아의 사복은 거의 본 기억이 없네

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나중에 기회가 되면 한 번 보여 드릴게요.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, this is Noa.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can make my Student Rep shift tomorrow.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I woke up with a small fever, but it's gotten worse throughout the day.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh no, is it bad?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry. I took some medicine, and I'm already feeling better.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But I am concerned about getting you sick if I go to Schale in this condition.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry for the last-minute cancellation.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry about me. Just rest up!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: If anything happens, feel free to contact me anytime.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes, have a good night, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hello, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My cold has kept me from visiting you lately.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Have you been keeping healthy?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course, I'm fine.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Are you feeling better now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm all healed up!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So if it's okay with you...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you mind coming over to my room again this weekend?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Your room?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Last time you were here, you promised to help me decorate.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You didn't forget, did you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Ah! Yeah! Of course I do!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I was asking just in case!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Fufu, you don't have to be so flustered.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was just teasing you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then I'll see you this weekend.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, are you okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I heard from another student that you caught a cold...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh, Noa.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm okay. I get to take some time off for the first time in a while.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Even if you say it's okay,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can't help but feel like I got you sick.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I feel so bad...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's not your fault, Noa.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry about it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But still...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, you don't have anything special planned tomorrow, do you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is it okay if I come visit around lunchtime, then?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I don't mind you coming by, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Will you have time? You don't have any Seminar duties?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's okay. I've already handled all the work that piled up during my sick leave.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you tomorrow.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's been nice that the weather has cooled down with the rain,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: but on the other hand, my laundry isn't drying fast enough.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I understand that feeling...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: And if you hang your laundry out to dry for too long, it can start to smell.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: By the way, how many school uniforms do you have, Noa?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Including extras, about 4 sets?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The dress code at Millennium isn't very strict,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: so I doubt most students own duplicates of the same exact uniform.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But I'm part of Seminar, you know?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Come to think of it, I never see you in casual clothes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hm... What a shame...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll show you one day, when we get the chance.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ฉันโนอานะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอโทษนะคะ แต่พรุ่งนี้ฉันน่าจะไป
เข้าเวรที่ชาเล่ต์ไม่ได้แล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันมีไข้ต่ำๆ ตั้งแต่เช้าแล้ว
แล้วพอตกเย็น อาการของฉันก็ยิ่งแย่ลง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เป็นเรื่องใหญ่แล้วแฮะ
ไม่สบายมากหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ต้องเป็นห่วงหรอกค่ะ ฉันกินยา
เข้าไปแล้ว ก็เลยดีขึ้นมาหน่อยแล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่แค่เกรงว่าถ้าไปที่ชาเล่ต์ จะยิ่ง
เป็นการเพิ่มภาระให้คุณครูเปล่าๆ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอโทษที่ขอเปลี่ยนตารางอย่าง
กะทันหันนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ต้องห่วงครูนะ พักรักษาตัวก่อนเถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้ามีเรื่องอะไรก็บอกครูนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ ราตรีสวัสดิ์นะคะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สวัสดีค่ะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตั้งแต่ไม่สบาย ฉันก็ไม่ได้ไปหาคุณครู
นานเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูแข็งแรงดีมั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูแข็งแรงอยู่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โนอาดีขึ้นบ้างแล้วหรือยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ ต้องขอบคุณคุณครูด้วยค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ว่า ถ้าคุณครูไม่ว่าอะไร

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
สุดสัปดาห์นี้ช่วยมาที่ห้องของฉัน
อีกรอบจะได้มั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ห้องของโนอาเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ครั้งที่แล้วคุณครูบอกว่าจะมาช่วย
ตกแต่งห้องให้ฉันไม่ใช่เหรอคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อย่าบอกนะคะว่าแค่ไม่กี่วัน แต่คุณครูก็
ลืมหมดแล้ว?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ตะ... ต้องจำได้อยู่แล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูแค่ถามไปงั้นน่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ ไม่ต้องตกใจขนาดนั้นก็ได้ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันล้อเล่นค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นไว้เจอกันสุดสัปดาห์นี้นะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู เป็นยังไงบ้างคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันได้ยินจากนักเรียนคนอื่นว่าคุณครู
ไม่สบาย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ โนอาเองเหรอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูไม่เป็นไร พอไม่สบายก็เลยได้
พักผ่อนน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงจะบอกว่าไม่เป็นไรก็เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ฉันคิดว่าคุณครูติดหวัดจากฉัน
ตอนมาหาฉันคราวก่อน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็เลยเป็นกังวลน่ะค่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ใช่ความผิดของโนอาหรอกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ต้องกังวลหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงอย่างนั้นก็เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู พรุ่งนี้มีนัดอะไรเป็นพิเศษมั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าไม่มีนัดอะไร ฉันแวะเข้าไปเยี่ยมไข้
ตอนกลางวันได้มั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะมาครูก็ไม่ว่าหรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่จะไม่เป็นไรเหรอ? งานที่เซมิน่า
ไม่ยุ่งเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่เป็นไรค่ะ ฉันเคลียร์งานที่ค้างไว้
ระหว่างที่ลาป่วยเสร็จหมดแล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นไว้เจอกันพรุ่งนี้นะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มันก็ดีอยู่ที่อากาศเย็นขึ้นเพราะฝนตก
ติดต่อมาหลายวัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ชุดนักเรียนที่ฉันซักไว้ยังไม่แห้ง
เลยค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูเข้าใจดีเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
พอตากผ้าชื้นๆ ไว้นานๆ ก็อาจจะ
มีกลิ่นได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ว่าแต่โนอามีชุดนักเรียนกี่ชุดเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้านับชุดที่ซื้อมาไว้เผื่อด้วย
รวมๆ แล้วก็สี่ชุดค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่กฏเรื่องเครื่องแบบนักเรียนของ
มิลเลเนียมไม่ได้เข้มงวดนัก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็เลยไม่ค่อยมีนักเรียนที่มีชุดนักเรียน
ชุดเดียวกันหลายๆ ชุด...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ว่าฉันเป็นสมาชิกของเซมิน่านี่คะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
จะว่าไป ครูก็ไม่ค่อยเห็นชุดอื่นของ
โนอาเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: น่าเสียดายจัง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ถ้ามีโอกาส ฉันจะใส่ชุดอื่นให้ดูค่ะ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，我是乃愛

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 非常抱歉，明天我恐怕無法如期到夏萊完成值日生的工作了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天從早上就有點發燒，到下午又更嚴重了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真糟糕。身體會很不舒服嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不用擔心。吃過藥後已經比較好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我只是擔心如果用這種狀態去夏萊，反而會給老師添麻煩……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 突然調整日程真的很抱歉

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不用擔心，你好好休息吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 如果有事隨時可以跟我說

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 好的，老師晚安

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你好，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為感冒的關係，很久沒去見老師了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 最近過得還好嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我過得很好哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 乃愛的身體有比較好了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是，這都多虧了老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 話說回來，如果方便的話

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這週末能請老師到我的房間來一趟嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 去乃愛的房間……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 哎呀

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 上次老師來探病的時候，不是跟我約好下次要幫我裝飾房間嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 難道這段期間，老師已經忘記了自己的承諾嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我，我當然記得！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 只是隨口問一下而已！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，老師不必這麼慌張

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我只是開個玩笑而已

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼我們週末見

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你身體還好嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我聽其他學生說你感冒了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 啊，是乃愛啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我沒事。多虧感冒也能難得休息一下

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然老師說沒事

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但我有點擔心

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是不是之前來看我的時候被我傳染了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這不是乃愛的錯

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 別放在心上

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可是……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師明天應該沒有特別的行程吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我可以在中午左右過去探病嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 可以是可以……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這樣好嗎？研討會的工作會不會忙不過來？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不必擔心。病假期間累積的工作，都已經妥善處理完畢了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼明天見

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為這幾天一直下雨的關係，天氣漸漸變涼爽了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然洗好的制服一直不乾，讓人有點煩惱就是了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我能理解那種心情……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 有時候衣服曬太久會有味道對吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 話說回來，乃愛有幾套制服呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 包括備用的在內大約有4套吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 由於千年的服儀規定並不是特別嚴格

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以幾乎沒有學生會有好幾套相同的制服……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但我畢竟是研討會的幹部

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這麼說來，我幾乎沒見過乃愛穿便服的樣子呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 突然覺得有點可惜……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之後有機會的話，我會讓老師看看的
